title: Condensates of the chromatin regulator ANKRD11 restrict hypertranscribed genes to safeguard development
title_zh: 染色质调控因子ANKRD11的凝聚体限制高转录基因以保护发育过程
abstract: Genes that define cell identity are often highly transcribed, but how their activity is regulated to prevent pathological dysregulation remains elusive. Using a two-tiered genetic screen, we identify a network of genes regulating hypertranscribed loci, which is notably enriched for genes mutated in developmental disorders. Among these, ANKRD11, a chromatin regulator haploinsufficient in KBG syndrome, exerts progressively stronger repression on more highly transcribed genes. ANKRD11 enriches around hypertranscribed loci and forms biomolecular condensates via charge-block-patterned intrinsically disordered regions. These condensates spatially sequester elongation factors away from RNA polymerase II, thereby restricting transcription elongation. In mice, Ankrd11 loss abrogates this restriction, causing aberrant developmental gene activation, disrupted organogenesis, and embryonic lethality. Critically, KBG patient cells with ANKRD11 mutations show defective condensate formation and consequent overactivation of hypertranscribed genes. These results uncover a condensate-mediated mechanism that restricts hypertranscribed genes and suggest its disruption underlies developmental disorders such as KBG syndrome.
abstract_zh: 定义细胞身份的基因通常转录水平很高，但其活性如何被调节以避免病理性失控仍不清楚。我们采用两级遗传筛选，发现一个调控高转录位点的基因网络，该网络明显富集了发育障碍相关致病基因。其中，ANKRD11——一种在KBG综合征中表现为单拷贝不足的染色质调控因子——对高转录基因表现出随转录水平上升而逐步增强的抑制作用。ANKRD11在高转录位点周围富集，并通过带有电荷分段模式的内源性无序区域形成生物分子凝聚体。这些凝聚体在空间上将延伸因子从RNA聚合酶II附近隔离，从而限制转录延伸。在小鼠中，Ankrd11缺失解除这种限制，导致异常的发育基因激活、器官发生紊乱和胚胎致死。关键的是，携带ANKRD11突变的KBG患者细胞显示凝聚体形成缺陷，继而使高转录基因过度激活。这些结果揭示了一种由凝聚体介导的限制高转录基因机制，并提示其破坏是KBG综合征等发育障碍的潜在原因。
